client_brief:
Kilnmore wholesale relaunch: preserve the glazes across the full campaign

The relaunch needs to look like one Kilnmore range. We have fourteen captures from two very different mornings, covering thirteen pieces, and four glazes that customers must still be able to distinguish after correction.

We need the photography and product cutouts resolved alongside the editable wholesale and launch pieces. Please reconcile coverage before treating capture count as product count.

Campaign set
Relaunch set: wholesale deck, paid canvases, storefront banners, spec tile, range one pager, mark and type page: One professionally selected Adobe Express template adapted to the supplied brand, copy, and approved imagery. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

Range masters
Fourteen captures from two very different mornings brought to one house neutral with the four glazes still distinguishable from one another, delivered as a hero and a detail per piece at consistent piece scale across the range, plus one licensed context frame graded into the same neutral or a written record of why none was carried. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions, with a per-frame parameter log, one line per-frame on why it differs from its neighbours, a note of what refused to respond, and all reported crop limitations recorded.

Product-page cutouts
Thirteen pieces isolated onto the agreed tile ground, cut on the piece's own edge with nothing bitten out of a rim where glaze and linen sit at the same value, and with handle voids genuinely open rather than holding a patch of backdrop. Isolation route recorded per piece, because a dark piece standing clear of the cloth and a pale matte piece against it cannot be produced the same way, and true glaze colour preserved through the isolation since a buyer chooses from these pictures.

Pale matte rims against linen will need care. Preserve the actual glaze colour through isolation, and leave handle openings genuinely clear. If a licensed context photograph does not fit the range, a documented decision to leave it out is acceptable.

Supplied pack: range_captures/ (14 frames, 4200 x 2800); kilnmore_mark_tile.jpg; linesheet_2025_PRINT.pdf; range_data.csv; brand_notes.txt plus counter_2024.jpg.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

Fee range: $3,000-$7,000 fixed
Delivery target: 2 to 4 weeks
Included reviews: One direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork 'Graphic designer, advertising creatives' open call from a direct to consumer homeware brand wanting 'high-performing static ad creatives, promotional graphics, and multiple creative variations for testing across our paid social campaigns', working 'from existing brand guidelines', with 'clean, modern, conversion-focused visuals'. Co-anchors: the Freelancer.com brief from a small shop wanting a product photographer for ten to fifteen catalogue shots and a logo, honestly re-cast here as the post production half a product photographer actually does at the desk, since the connector cannot operate a camera and cannot draw a mark from scratch, so the client sends its own raw captures and a photographed hand inked mark; the Freelancer.com brief from a vendor with 'product descriptions and a clean image set already prepared' needing the specification bearing catalogue material a retail intake team approves, repositioned to record per page because a multi product grid catalogue is not producible on this surface; and the Freelancer.com 'Modern Store Graphics Package' brief for an online shop refreshing its storefront with a hero banner sized for desktop and for mobile, product detail assets plus iconography, and section graphics, art directed as 'clean lines, bold but balanced color, plenty of negative space, nothing fussy', with layered source files requested alongside the exports. Laundered to the fictional Kilnmore; no real company, person, marketplace, platform or trademark appears.

price_band_and_audience: Mugs 34 dollars, bowls 42 dollars, a serving platter 96 dollars, a four piece dinner set 180 dollars; wholesale at roughly half of retail with a six piece opening minimum. Two audiences: direct buyers aged 28 to 50 who own two or three considered kitchen objects and are choosing between this and a comparable studio line, and independent home goods stockists whose buyers judge a range on whether the line sheet is legible and complete enough to order from. The band is load-bearing. At this tier the correct artefact is calm and full frame: one piece given room, a house neutral that does not move between tiles, dimensions and prices set plainly in the run of the sheet, and space used as the argument. Push it toward impulse marketplace grammar, a tiled grid of nine pieces, price flashes, a countdown strip, three exclamation colours, and a thirty four dollar mug reads as an eight dollar mug and a wholesale buyer closes the sheet, which is the exact commercial failure the client is describing when they say calm and nothing fussy. Push it the other way into gallery austerity with the pieces small and the type tiny and a buyer cannot read the dimensions they need to order from. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,600 dollars fixed, or 45 to 75 dollars an hour across 35 to 55 hours.

brand_identity.typography: One warm, legible system: a quiet humanist serif for the mark, headings and range names, paired with a clean sans for the specification tables and dimensions so a stockist reads them without effort. Warmth without decoration, nothing script, nothing ornamented.

There is no working file. The mark has to be recovered from the photograph as artwork the studio can use at any size before the relaunch can carry it. The written guideline survives, plus a phone snap of the shop counter kept as a warmth reference.
brand_identity.values: Honest materials shown plainly, and one line that reads as one line across every piece and every page.

assets_supplied.name: range_captures/ (14 frames, 4200 x 2800)
assets_supplied.kind: The studio's own captures of thirteen pieces on the workbench by the window, shot across two mornings on the same linen backdrop.
assets_supplied.visible_description: 'Two mornings on the same bench with the same cloth. Honest, but not consistent.'
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: One morning was flat overcast and the other was direct sun, so the glazes read at two different temperatures and the sun morning's glaze breaks are fully clipped, which means an attempt to recover them reports success while nothing in the picture moves. Separately, the oatmeal and ash pieces sit at almost the same value as the linen behind them, so an isolation of those pieces reports success and quietly bites the rim, and the pieces with closed handles keep the linen trapped inside the handle void.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_mark_tile.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: A photograph of the studio's hand inked mark, brushed years ago onto an unglazed clay tile that now sits on the bench.
assets_supplied.visible_description: 'The mark as it was originally inked on a tile. It is the only version that exists.'
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The brushed ink and the unglazed clay it sits on are close in value, so a selection that names the tile returns the tile rather than the ink and every downstream step then works on a rectangle. The ligature in the mark encloses a counter that a one call knockout fills with captured clay while reporting complete success.

assets_supplied.name: linesheet_2025_PRINT.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF of last season's wholesale line sheet, US Letter portrait, one piece per page, fonts embedded, produced from the studio's own data through a full print engine. Carries a piece photograph, a name and description block, a nine row specification table, a care and firing note and both prices.
assets_supplied.visible_description: 'What the printer sent us last season. We do not have the working file and nobody here knows how it was put together. Keep it exactly as it is.'
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The specification table came out of the studio's system as one continuous story with tab characters between each parameter and its value, so there are no per parameter frames to map and everything has to be driven by ordered offsets inside a single story. The readout of that story silently omits the run holding the care and firing note while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed, every offset past it is short by exactly that run's length, the validator still reports valid, and the fields past the omission never become placeholders at all.

assets_supplied.name: range_data.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export of the season's range, one row per piece, with columns for piece code, name, description, nine specification parameters, care and firing note, retail price, wholesale price and an image column.
assets_supplied.visible_description: 'Our range data. The dimensions and the care note are what a stockist orders against, so they are held to as written.'
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Fifteen rows for thirteen live pieces: two discontinued glazes the system still emits, flagged only by a retired column the client never mentions. Two pieces have their dimensions entered in centimetres while the rest are in inches, with no unit marker anywhere in the row, and the image column holds full local paths without the prefix the merge's own image contract requires.

assets_supplied.name: brand_notes.txt plus counter_2024.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: A page of the studio's existing written guideline, plus a phone snap of the shop counter kept as a warmth reference.
assets_supplied.visible_description: 'Clean lines, balanced colour, plenty of negative space, nothing fussy. And a picture of our counter, because that warmth is the thing we keep losing when someone else designs for us.'

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the isolation actually followed the piece. On the oatmeal and ash pieces the matte glaze and the linen behind them sit at nearly the same value, so the cut reports complete success and returns a plausible looking cutout that has taken a bite out of the rim where the two meet, and on the pieces with closed handles it keeps the linen trapped inside the handle void as an opaque patch of backdrop. At tile scale on a white page both look correct. Which pieces behave this way is a property of these particular captures, this particular glaze against this particular cloth in this particular light, and it is not predictable from the range list, the glaze note or a preview of the frame.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot either, because the tool returns no separation measure, no warning and no confidence for this, and the artefact it returns is a clean well formed cutout rather than an obviously broken one. The only route to the answer is to run the isolation on each piece and look at the result on the ground it will actually sit on at the size it will actually sit at. Nothing states it: the brief asks for tiles of each piece and says the glazes matter, which is an ordinary client requirement, and no asset description names which pieces are at risk.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-route the affected pieces through a material named selection of the piece, inverted and filled to the tile ground, rather than through the one call cut, and open the enclosed handle voids the same way. Then re-judge the whole set on the tile ground, because two isolation routes give different edge character and a range in which four pieces have a softer edge than the other nine does not read as one line, which in practice means re-deriving some of the nine as well and re-taking the ground decision for all thirteen.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A product page in which four of thirteen pieces have a chunk missing from the rim and a patch of someone's linen sitting inside the handle, sold to buyers who are choosing this line over a comparable one on the evidence of the photograph.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's line sheet actually exposes, and then whether the mapping built against it landed. The specification table came out of the studio's system as one continuous story with tabs between parameter and value, so there are no per parameter frames and everything has to be driven by ordered offsets. The second fact is worse: the readout of that story omits the run holding the care and firing note while keeping its line break, so the string still parses as well formed, every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length, the validator returns valid on arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, the placeholder step reports success, and the fields past the omission never become placeholders at all.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Granularity is not a parameter, is not reported before conversion and has no read ahead, so the only route to it is to convert, export and read. The yield failure defeats diligence rather than carelessness, because an agent that reads the readout carefully and computes offsets correctly from it produces a mapping every downstream tool agrees with; the only defence is an independent reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two strings disagree. And it is not a propagation re-run, because the source of truth behind the mapping changes and the whole mapping is re-authored with re-ordered same uid rows.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story by concatenating the document's own content runs, recompute every offset against that string, re-order rows sharing a uid so their positions hold against the original text, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-run the template preparation, and re-verify by round-tripping the document and grepping for every placeholder before a single page is merged. Settle which of the two graphic frames holds the piece photograph by rendering a page and reading it against the 2025 printed reference rather than by assuming the larger frame is the photograph.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Thirteen wholesale line sheets that bind the name, the description and most of the specification table correctly while the care and firing note and the field after it are silently absent from every page, printed and handed to stockists who order against exactly those values, with every tool in the chain having reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed context frame actually sits with the range. At search time the only thing visible is a small preview, and a small preview cannot tell you the frame's real colour behaviour, how its own light compares with the house neutral fixed days earlier, or what its props do next to these glazes. The full resolution file is a different picture: its window light may run cooler or greener than the studio bench, its own crockery may be glossy where this range is matte, or it may carry a warm wood table that pulls the whole opener away from the neutral every tile was built to. None of that resolves until the licensed file is downloaded, graded and put adjacent to the graded range.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it, because the licensing step is the only way to see the real file and the preview is a small proxy with no colour fidelity, so no amount of care at search time yields the answer. Nothing states it: the brief never mentions a stock frame at all and the acceptance bar only says the work must read as one line. And it is not a propagation re-run, because the response may be to license a different frame entirely, to re-decide how far the context frame can be graded before it stops being a plausible photograph, or to conclude that this range does not carry a lifestyle frame and to re-plan the deck opener and the wide banner around the range itself.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Download at full resolution, grade toward the house neutral, and judge it beside the graded range rather than on its own. Where it cannot be brought into the house look without becoming implausible, search again with a different short query and license a replacement, and where no frame works, re-author the deck opener and the wide banner to carry a piece from the range instead, which changes the argument each of those canvases makes. Record the licensing decisions and the frame that was rejected in the handover.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A wholesale deck that opens on a warm glossy table setting and a storefront banner built on it, both quietly at odds with every product tile behind them, in a relaunch whose one stated requirement was that the range read as one line.

decision_gates: Which morning sets the house neutral, knowing the other one will need a materially different correction to arrive at the same place.
How far to correct the sun morning before the correction itself becomes a glaze change a buyer can see, and what to do with breaks that will not come back.
Piece scale policy across thirteen tiles, decided as a set rather than per tile, and re-decided once any tile is derived a different way.
Isolation route per piece, where a one call cut is right for a dark piece clear of the cloth and returns a bitten rim and a filled handle on a pale matte piece against pale linen.
How the ink is named in the mark selection prompt, since naming the tile it sits on pulls the mask to the tile and every downstream step then operates on a rectangle.
Whether to trust the mapping readout of the studio's own specification table or to reconstruct the story independently from the document.
Which of two indistinguishable graphic frames holds the piece photograph rather than the second graphic element.
Whether a success message counts as verification of the prepared template.

All thirteen pieces read as one line shot on one morning, judged with the range laid out together rather than one piece at a time.
Every product page tile shows the whole piece at a consistent scale across the range. A tile that shows part of a piece is a rejected tile even if it is a good picture.
Cutouts are cut on the piece's own edge, with nothing bitten out of a rim and no backdrop left trapped inside a handle.
The mark comes back as artwork that scales, sits clean and transparent on any ground, and keeps its enclosed counter open at the sizes we use it.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.

why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these captures into a frontier image model and it returns beautiful ceramics. IDENTITY: these are thirteen specific pieces in four specific glazes that a buyer orders and a stockist stocks, and a generated bowl is a bowl that does not exist, which on a page also carrying dimensions and a wholesale price is a false product claim. The mark has the same problem: it was inked by hand on a tile years ago and the client needs that drawing recovered, not a new one. SPEC: the client needs one sheet per live piece at US Letter and 300 ppi with nine specification values bound verbatim from their own range export, thirteen separately named sheet files each containing the piece their filename claims, a hero tile per piece showing the whole piece at consistent scale, two fixed banner canvases at two declared sizes, and no delivered file larger than its source. None of that can be produced or checked by generation. EDITABILITY: two deliverables are defined by being editable, a live merge template so next season's range is a data change, and a native document with live text, a real price table and real vector artwork so copy and pieces can be swapped by the studio itself. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did this cut follow the rim, is this handle open, did this placeholder get created, is this care note complete at trim, do these four glazes still read as four glazes. That is not a generation problem.
